map_readings.label: Lucky Creek FSR

Road section label printed beside the highlighted road between the POC arrow and Kite Lake.
Road section label printed beside the highlighted road near its north-eastern end.
Further 8612 section labels printed along the southern and eastern parts of the highlighted road are partly hidden under the cyan line and cannot be read in full.
